content.hero.title: Left Hand Lucy
content.services.ps.desc: When life gets busy, I can help. From admin to scheduling and task organisation, I'll help you stay on track, meet deadlines, and keep projects moving.
content.hero.intro: I'm Lucy - an experienced Executive Assistant, event planner and organiser based in Madrid. I support businesses, and individuals with everything from day-to-day organisation to events and experiences, both remotely and in person.
content.testimonials.t1.name: Julia Lopez
content.testimonials.t2.text: I've tried a few English tutors over the years, but Lucy stands out immediately. Her teaching style is clear, patient, and completely tailored to what I need. I really look forward to our sessions each week.
content.testimonials.t4.text: I have recently started my own business and I was struggling with keeping myself organised with all of the admin and prioritisation. I hired Lucy to help me organise things and within a couple of weeks there was already a huge difference. She's very reliable and nothing is ever too much trouble.
content.testimonials.t5.text: My daughter's confidence in English has really improved since starting lessons with Lucy. She makes it feel like fun, not an extra hour at school. We couldn't be happier.
content.testimonials.t1.text: Lucy helps me as a VA for a few hours a week and the amount of time it gives back to me to do other things, is incredible. I couldn't be happier!
